try { String[] q = new String[] { "Aaj jo kaam tum ne khud kiya, kal wo kaun karega?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Hum haqeeqat se kam, apne khayalon se zyada dukh uthate hain.

— 🏛 Seneca", "Dukan tumhare baghair ek din chale to kya tootega? Wahi tumhara agla kaam hai.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Masroof hona aur aage barhna do alag cheezein hain. Aaj tum kaun se the?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Zindagi chhoti nahi hai, hum us ka bara hissa zaya kar dete hain.

— 🏛 Seneca", "Jis par tumhe bharosa nahi, us ko tum ne sikhaya kya hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo cheez napi nahi jati, wo sudharti nahi.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Tumhara bas apne zehan par hai, bahar ke waqiyat par nahi. Yeh samajh lo, taqat mil jayegi.

— 👑 Marcus Aurelius", "Aankhein ek hi jori hain. Dukan doosri ban sakti hai.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Bachon ko tumhara paisa yaad nahi rahega, tumhara waqt yaad rahega.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo rukawat raaste mein hai, wohi raasta ban jati hai.

— 👑 Marcus Aurelius", "Aaj ka sab se zaroori kaam kaun sa tha, aur tum ne us ki jagah kya kiya?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Tum system bana rahe ho, ya system ke mulazim ban gaye ho?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Insaan ko cheezein pareshan nahi kartin, un ke bare mein us ki raaye pareshan karti hai.

— ⛓ Epictetus", "Agar yeh phone abhi band ho jaye, to kya waqai kuch bigrega?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo faisla tum taal rahe ho, wo bhi ek faisla hai.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Kal main hoshyar tha, duniya badalna chahta tha. Aaj danishmand hoon, khud ko badal raha hoon.

— 🌙 Rumi", "Das saal baad ka Samiullah aaj ke kis kaam par shukria kahega?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Ghussa us par aata hai jo humare bas mein nahi. Kya yeh tumhare bas mein hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jis ke paas jeene ka 'kyun' ho, wo har 'kaise' seh leta hai.

— ⚡ Nietzsche", "Paisa wapas aa jata hai, waqt nahi. Aaj ka waqt kis par kharch hua?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Tum jis cheez se bhaag rahe ho, wo aksar wahi hoti hai jo tumhe karni hai.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Insaan ki saari museebatein is se hain ke wo ek kamre mein akela chup nahi baith sakta.

— 🕯 Pascal", "Sasta mulazim sab se mehnga parta hai. Tum kis par bachat kar rahe ho?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Agar aaj ka din dobara mile, to kaun sa ek ghanta badlo ge?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Zindagi peeche dekh kar samajh aati hai, magar jeeni aage dekh kar parti hai.

— 🧭 Kierkegaard", "Tum kis ki tareef ke liye itni mehnat kar rahe ho?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Agar paisa masla na hota, to kal subah kya karte?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Kisi cheez ki asal qeemat zindagi ka wo hissa hai jo tum us ke badle dete ho.

— 🌲 Thoreau", "Jo kaam tum sirf aadat se kar rahe ho, us ka faida ab bhi hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Aaj kis ne tum se kuch seekha?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Kitna aahista chal rahe ho yeh aham nahi, jab tak rukte nahi.

— 🎋 Confucius", "Tumhara sab se achha mulazim kal chhor de, to kya tayyari hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Gahak tumhari dukan par kyun aata hai: rate, bharosa, ya aadat?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo doosron ko jaanta hai aqalmand hai; jo khud ko jaanta hai roshan hai.

— ☯ Lao Tzu", "Tum ne aakhri dafa 'mujhe nahi pata' kab kaha?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jis baat par aaj ghussa aaya, ek saal baad yaad bhi rahegi?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jis zindagi ko parkha na jaye, wo jeene ke laiq nahi.

— 🏛 Suqraat", "Tum mehnat zyada kar rahe ho, ya sahi cheez par kar rahe ho?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Aaj ghar walon ne tumhara chehra dekha, ya sirf phone ki roshni?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo har jagah hai, wo kahin nahi hai.

— 🏛 Seneca", "Jo cheez tum control nahi kar sakte, us par aaj kitna waqt gaya?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Ek cheez jo aaj chhor do to zindagi halki ho jaye, wo kya hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jab tak hum taalte rehte hain, zindagi guzar jati hai.

— 🏛 Seneca", "Tum mulazim ko ghalti par daant-te ho, ya tareeqa sikhate ho?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Karobar bara karna hai ya behtar? Dono ek cheez nahi.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Qismat wahan milti hai jahan tayyari aur mauqa ikathe hon.

— 🏛 Seneca", "Jism ne aaj kya maanga tha jo tum ne nahi diya?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Agar tumhara beta tumhe sara din dekhe, to kya seekhega?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Behtareen badla yeh hai ke tum us jaise na bano.

— 👑 Marcus Aurelius", "Tum jo jaante ho wo likha hua hai, ya sirf tumhare sar mein hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Sab kuch khud karna taqat nahi, kamzori hai. Aaj kya saunpa?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo cheez chhatte ke liye achhi nahi, wo makkhi ke liye bhi achhi nahi.

— 👑 Marcus Aurelius", "Aaj shukr kis cheez ka kiya?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Agla bara faisla dar se kar rahe ho, ya soch se?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Pehle khud se kaho tum kya banna chahte ho, phir wo karo jo karna hai.

— ⛓ Epictetus", "Jo dost sach bolta hai, us se aakhri dafa kab mile?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Nayi cheez banani hai, ya purani ko theek chalana hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Ameer wo nahi jis ke paas zyada hai, wo hai jis ki zarooratein kam hain.

— ⛓ Epictetus", "Tumhari dukan mein sab se zyada waqt kahan zaya hota hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Aaram bhi kaam ka hissa hai. Aaj us ka hissa diya?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Ghussa karna aasan hai. Sahi shakhs par, sahi hadd tak, sahi waqt par ghussa karna mushkil hai.

— 📜 Arastu", "Jis cheez ko tum 'baad mein' keh rahe ho, us ka 'baad' kab hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Log tumhare saath kaam karna chahte hain, ya majboor hain?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Koi aadmi ek hi darya mein do dafa nahi utarta. Darya bhi badal chuka hota hai aur aadmi bhi.

— 🌊 Heraclitus", "Nuqsan se mehnga hai nuqsan se na seekhna. Pichhla sabaq kya tha?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Aaj tum ne suna zyada, ya bola zyada?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Sab se bari fatah apne aap par fatah hai.

— 📜 Aflatoon", "Jo aadat tumhe sab se zyada rokti hai, us ka naam lo.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Aaj ki kamai mein se kitna sukoon kamaya?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Hazaar meel ka safar ek qadam se shuru hota hai.

— ☯ Lao Tzu", "Jis kaam se dil ghabrata hai, aksar wahi sab se zaroori hota hai. Wo kaun sa hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Tum apne waqt ke malik ho, ya phone ke?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo jaanta hai ke us ke paas kaafi hai, wohi ameer hai.

— ☯ Lao Tzu", "Ek saal pehle ka masla yaad hai? Aaj wala bhi aise hi guzar jayega.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Chhoti chori maaf karna bari chori ki dawat hai. Tumhara usool kya hai?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo ghalti kar ke use theek nahi karta, wo doosri ghalti kar raha hai.

— 🎋 Confucius", "Seekhna band, barhna band. Is hafte kya naya seekha?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Zindagi mehdood hai, yeh yaad ho to chhoti baatein chhoti lagti hain. Aaj kaun si baat bari lag rahi thi?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Jo cheez mujhe maar nahi deti, mujhe mazboot kar deti hai.

— ⚡ Nietzsche", "Udhaar dena aasan hai, wapas lena hunar hai. Aaj kis ka khata sota raha?

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Bharosa de kar dekho: log aksar utne hi bare ho jate hain jitna tum unhein samjho.

— 🪞 Apne aap se", "Har shakhs apni nazar ki hadd ko duniya ki hadd samajh leta hai.

— 🔭 Schopenhauer", "Zakhm wo jagah hai jahan se roshni andar aati hai.

— 🌙 Rumi", "Jo tum dhoond rahe ho, wo bhi tumhe dhoond raha hai.

— 🌙 Rumi", "Har koi duniya badalne ka sochta hai, khud ko badalne ka koi nahi.

— 🪶 Tolstoy", "Jo kaam hona hi nahi chahiye, use bohat achhe tareeqe se karne se zyada bekaar kuch nahi.

— 📊 Peter Drucker", "Kamyab aur bohat kamyab logon mein farq yeh hai ke bohat kamyab log taqreeban har cheez ko 'nahi' kehte hain.

— 💼 Warren Buffett", "Ulta socho: yeh pata ho ke main kahan girunga, to wahan jaun hi na.

— 💼 Charlie Munger", "Tayyari mein nakaami, nakaami ki tayyari hai.

— ⚙ Benjamin Franklin", "Darakht lagane ka behtareen waqt bees saal pehle tha. Doosra behtareen waqt aaj hai.

— 🌳 Kahawat", "Sabr talkh hai, magar us ka phal meetha hai.

— 🌳 Kahawat" }; int n = q.length; int per = 6; int nb = (n + per - 1) / per; long d2 = ((System.currentTimeMillis() + 18000000L) / 86400000L) / 2L; int b = (int) (d2 % nb); int from = b * per; int i = (from + (int) (Math.random() * per)) % n; return q[i]; } catch (Throwable t) { return "Aaj ka sab se zaroori kaam kaun sa hai?"; }
